text: Why is a device's configuration described as an accumulated liability rather than an asset?
choices: It grows monotonically, nothing removes it by default, its rationale is undocumented, and each layer of exception makes the next change harder to reason about
It is difficult to back up
explanation: A ten-year-old firewall policy contains rules referencing decommissioned servers that nobody dares remove because nobody knows what would break. Hit counters, golden configurations and periodic review with a defined removal process are the countermeasures.
